name: Laws Of Man
overview: Scripture teaches that human laws and authorities are established by God and should be respected, as believers are called to be subject to governing powers and obey magistrates (Romans 13:1; Titus 3:1). However, when the demands of man’s laws conflict with God’s commands, obedience to God must take precedence, as demonstrated by the apostles who declared they must obey God rather than men (Acts 5:29). Additionally, the judgment of others under human laws is cautioned against, since those who judge are also guilty of sin (Romans 2:1).
